propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep executes one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, causing per-ticket lock holds of minutes and stalling all writers fleet-wide
The per-ticket walk misses entries that fall through to per-event wildcard git walks with leading-wildcard pathspecs that defeat pruning, making deployed cost worse than one-per-ticket
The sweep stages uncommitted event files from concurrent writers via unscoped `git add -A`, committing them under the compactor's chore message
The sweep never re-yields mid-run: it probes write_lock_is_busy once before starting but never between tickets, so writers arriving after start wait for the entire run

The fix must hoist the position-keyed map build outside the lock (one walk per sweep), thread it per ticket, and re-check that the map key shape matches position lookups not path lookups to avoid silent per-event fallback
